title: Zenith Station
physical_identity: Enormous damaged metal-and-glass space-station megastructure embedded in Level 0; believed to be a thick spherical shell around a hollow centre, with bedrooms, kitchens, gyms, greenhouses.
scale_topology: Very large, indoor, believed wholly inside Level 0; spherical shell dozens of city blocks thick; far from fully mapped.
anomalies: Level 0 seen from inside appears as stacked identical floors
Retains Level 0 hallucinations and impossibility of meeting other wanderers
lighting_sound: Mostly bright and about room temperature; damaged parts nearly dark. Sound not stated.
hazards: extreme cold or heat unsurvivable in damaged sections
items_communities: no outposts; not viable to live

entrances.method: walk from one section to another
entrances.conditions: extremely unlikely to encounter; B.N.T.G. may have secret method
entrances.quote: simply walking from one section to another

exits.quote: simply travelling back to its parent level
exited by random noclipping, usually leading to Level 1

signature_mechanic: Damaged station modules with per-module light/temperature states (normal, dark, lethal hot/cold) and hallucination cues; sliding doors; no other wanderers.
verticality: Not stated beyond the shell structure; keep modest; stacked-floors view of Level 0 is a vista only.
do_not: make Ria Valpuri a guaranteed NPC
add hostile robots or named entities
conflicts_notes: Opening and closing vignette (Ria Valpuri) is narrative; closing paragraph describes Level 0 halls, not the station. Sphere shape is only 'believed'.

key_quotes.quote: an enormous megastructure found embedded in Level 0
extreme cold or heat to the point of unsurvivability
the impossibility of coming into contact with other wanderers
exited by random noclipping, usually leading to Level 1
